title: alchemilla glaberrima var. othmarii
intro: Alchemilla glaberrima var. othmarii, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to alleviate menstrual discomfort, heavy bleeding, and other gynecological issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and astringent properties. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle include soothing the uterus, reducing bleeding, and calming cramps, making it a popular remedy for women's health concerns. The bioactive constituents of Lady's Mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
